name: Product Quantity
definition: Specifies the ordered quantity of a product.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Specifies the unit of measurement. For example, kilo, tons.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Quantity of a product on a line specified by a number. For example, 100 (kgs), 50 (pieces).

Factor.name: Factor
Factor.definition: Multiplication factor of measurement values. For example: goods that can be ordered by 36 pieces.

Product.name: Product
Product.definition: Specifies the type of goods and services linked to the quantity.

NetWeightRelatedLineItem.name: Net Weight Related Line Item
NetWeightRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which a net weight is specified.

BilledQuantityRelatedLineItem.name: Billed Quantity Related Line Item
BilledQuantityRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item which contains this quantity.

RelatedPackaging.name: Related Packaging
RelatedPackaging.definition: Packaging for which a quantity is specified.

PackagingForUnitQuantity.name: Packaging For Unit Quantity
PackagingForUnitQuantity.definition: Packaging for which a unit quantity per package is specified.

ChargeFreeQuantityRelatedLineItem.name: Charge Free Quantity Related Line Item
ChargeFreeQuantityRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which a charge free quantity of product is specified.

MeasureQuantityStart.name: Measure Quantity Start
MeasureQuantityStart.definition: Quantity value on which the quantity measurement started for a line item. For instance the start amount of a meter reading for an electricity supplier.

MeasureQuantityEnd.name: Measure Quantity End
MeasureQuantityEnd.definition: Quantity value on which the quantity measurement ended for a line item. For instance the end amount of a meter reading for an electricity supplier.

QuantityTolerance.name: Quantity Tolerance
QuantityTolerance.definition: Variance allowed in the quantity of goods.

PackagingForConsignmentlQuantity.name: Packaging For Consignmentl Quantity
PackagingForConsignmentlQuantity.definition: Packaging for which a total consignment quantity is specified.

PackagingForVolume.name: Packaging For Volume
PackagingForVolume.definition: Packaging for which a volume is specified.

PackagingForWeight.name: Packaging For Weight
PackagingForWeight.definition: Packaging for which a weight is specified.

GrossPriceQuantityRelatedLineItem.name: Gross Price Quantity Related Line Item
GrossPriceQuantityRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which gross price quantity is specified.

NetPriceQuantityRelatedLineItem.name: Net Price Quantity Related Line Item
NetPriceQuantityRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which a net price quantity is specified.

GrossWeightRelatedLineItem.name: Gross Weight Related Line Item
GrossWeightRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which a gross weight is specified.
